subject.title: [Bug]: Assistant text preceding a tool call in the same turn is silently dropped on Signal channel (Anthropic/Sonnet, non-streaming)

question: Should suppressed commentary text before tool calls be kept private from channels but marked as undelivered in provider replay so later model turns cannot treat it as seen by the user?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but OpenClaw also has an intentional policy to prevent pre-tool/internal narration from leaking into messaging channels, so maintainers need to choose the durable delivery/replay contract.

options.title: Accept Replay Markers
options.body: Land the linked replay-marker approach so hidden pre-tool commentary stays private but later model turns receive explicit context that it was not delivered.

options.title: Deliver Selected Pre-Tool Text
options.body: Require a different fix that safely flushes only intentional user-facing pre-tool text without reintroducing internal narration leaks.

options.title: Require Explicit Sends
options.body: Document bare pre-tool text as private and require `message(action=send)` or an equivalent explicit send path for channel-visible confirmations.

recommendation.title: Accept Replay Markers
recommendation.body: Land the linked replay-marker approach so hidden pre-tool commentary stays private but later model turns receive explicit context that it was not delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and recent history make this the strongest routing signal for the shared replay/commentary boundary.
